questions.question: Sojourner was designed to work for about 7 sols. How many sols did it actually operate?
questions.explanation: Sojourner was active for 83 sols (about 85 Earth days) before the Pathfinder lander it depended on stopped transmitting.

questions.question: What cut off contact with the Opportunity rover in June 2018?

options.text: A global dust storm that blocked its sunlight
It drove into a sand trap

questions.explanation: A planet-encircling dust storm starved its solar panels of power. NASA declared the mission complete on 13 February 2019.

questions.question: Which Apollo lunar rover drove the longest total distance?

options.text: They all drove the same distance

questions.explanation: The Apollo 17 rover covered about 35.9 km, compared with about 27.9 km (Apollo 15) and 26.7 km (Apollo 16).

questions.question: What did NASA conclude was the most probable reason Spirit stopped communicating?

options.text: Excessive cold that made its survival heaters ineffective

questions.explanation: Spirit was stuck in soft sand at a poor angle for the Martian winter. NASA ended recovery efforts on 25 May 2011.

questions.question: What name was given to the Mars Pathfinder lander after it landed?
questions.explanation: The lander was renamed the Carl Sagan Memorial Station. Columbia Memorial Station is the name given to Spirit's landing site.

questions.question: On which Apollo mission was the Lunar Roving Vehicle first driven?
questions.explanation: Apollo 15 carried the first Lunar Roving Vehicle; later ones flew on Apollo 16 and 17.

questions.question: Which astronauts drove the Apollo 16 rover across the Descartes Highlands?
questions.explanation: John Young and Charles Duke explored the Descartes Highlands during Apollo 16 in April 1972.
